Connect loyalty

An individual academic exploration of acquisition, engagement and advocacy across channels.

The question

How could a loyalty program organize a coherent journey across search, social, landing pages and follow-up?

The proposed approach

Use the program as the organizing layer for messaging, campaign concepts and automated follow-up.

The deliverable

A channel plan, funnel, campaign concepts, landing-page wireframe and workflow. Not commissioned by or affiliated with Aritzia.
